name: PipelineEventsTimeline

states.name: Pipeline Events Timeline
states.description: Users need a chronological timeline of generation pipeline events showing what happened during each phase of workflow generation.

states.name: Per-Event Metrics
states.description: Users need to see per-event metrics including duration in milliseconds, token counts, and validation error deltas to identify bottlenecks and measure improvement.

states.name: Phase Color Coding
states.description: Each pipeline phase is color-coded for quick identification: blue for discovery, green for generation, yellow for validation, orange for fixing, purple for hardening, cyan for reflection.

states.name: Loading and Empty States
states.description: Empty and loading states communicate pipeline status clearly.

states.name: Event Data Rendering
states.description: Each event row must accurately render the event type, phase, timestamp (HH:mm:ss format), duration in milliseconds, token count, and validation error delta from the API response.

states.name: Timeline Behavior
states.description: The timeline is scrollable when events exceed the visible area (max-h-96), events are ordered chronologically by created_at, and the timeline connector lines visually link sequential events.
states.precondition: More events exist than fit in the max-h-96 container

states.name: Required Timeline Elements
states.description: Each event row must contain a phase color dot, event type label, and timeline connector line. The header must show the Zap icon.

states.name: Virtualized Rendering and Pagination
states.description: The Pipeline Events timeline uses react-window virtualized rendering to handle large event lists efficiently. Events are paginated client-side (50 per page) with a 'Load more' button. The header shows a count indicator like '50 of 8297'. Only visible event rows plus a 10-row overscan buffer are rendered in the DOM.
states.precondition: More than 50 pipeline events exist for the task run

description: Pipeline Events Timeline — shows the sequence of events during workflow generation, including phase durations, token usage, and validation error changes, helping developers understand and debug the generation pipeline.
